chapters.reason: The paper introduces 'back attention' as a novel mechanism to enhance cross-layer information flow during multi-hop reasoning, directly aligning with the theory of information flow which studies how hidden information is transmitted across specialized layers.

The paper investigates how layer depth influences multi-hop reasoning capabilities, finding that a 1-layer transformer with back attention can match a 2-layer model, which relates to macro-level studies of the correlation between layer depth and reasoning.

The proposed 'back attention' is an explicit architectural modification that allows lower layers to leverage higher-layer states, implementing a form of continuous activation propagation across layers, which fits the description of Architectural Recurrence.
